description: A world of floating continents held aloft by gravity crystals. Sky-merchants trade between islands, guilds hoard crystal-tuning secrets, and storms of shifting gravity make travel dangerous. Flight between continents depends on rare crystal-powered vessels. I am a poor apprentice engineer on a small trading island.
